hesitate.desc: the go-to action for the undisciplined.

flinch.desc: flinch from pain. This move is added whenever you fall in combat.

adjust.desc: adjust the balance of your unwieldy weapon.

balance.desc: adjust the balance of your encumbering armor.

observe.desc: observe the enemy, gaining insight about their next moves.

rest.desc: heal 1 damage but become vulnerable for 2 turns. Ends turn.

adrenaline.desc: get +2 actions immediately but become vulnerable for 1 turn. Cannot be used when crippled. Uses breath.

sprint.desc: Disengage, forcing everyone nearby to change their target.

calm.desc: observe your foes. Get +2 actions next turn. Usable once per combat.

prepare.desc: observe your target and gain 2 block. Subsequent cast grants 2 additional block.

quick attack.desc: attack for 1 damage without spending a turn. Uses breath.

berserk.desc: Gain +1 action and refresh abilities for 2 turns, at the cost of 1 health. Uses breath.

evade.desc: become invulnerable for 1 turn. Must not be crippled.

stun.desc: stun an enemy for 1 turn. Ends turn.

charge.desc: charge at the enemy from afar for 1 damage.

bash.desc: gain 1 block. Bash the enemy to deal damage equal to current block.

strong bash.desc: gain 1 block. Bash everyone in melee to deal damage equal to current block.

roundhouse kick.desc: roundhouse kick the enemy to deal 2 damage and knock them out of range.

greater flurry.desc: deal 1 damage 2 times and apply vulnerability for 1 turn.
greater flurry.text: perform%s a great flurry of attacks

cleave.desc: deal 1 damage to everyone in melee range.

grand cleave.desc: deal 3 damage to your target and 2 damage to everyone around it.

whirlwind.desc: deal 1 damage to everyone in melee range 3 times.

tackle.desc: tackle the enemy, dealing 2 damage and stunning you both for a turn.

grand slam.desc: deal 3 damage and reduce target actions by 1. Ends turn.

bleeding edge.desc: deal 2 damage and 1 additional damage next turn.

riposte.desc: reflect the next hit with 3 damage.

greater riposte.desc: gain 1 block. Reflect the next hit with 3 damage.

acidic slash.desc: remove target's block and attack twice for 2 damage. Ends turn.

whirring slash.desc: attack for 2 damage and apply vulnerability for 1 turn.

slash.desc: attack for 2 damage. Target takes 1 bleeding damage from subsequent slashes.

rip.desc: remove target's block and deal 1 damage.

acrobatics.desc: gain 1 block and disengage, then apply vulnerability to your target for the turn.

somersault.desc: deal 1 damage, break guard, and disengage. Empowers your next somersault or acrobatics. Engages and deals 3 damage when empowered.

assassinate.desc: Kill the enemy if their health is lower than 6. Ends turn. Usable once per combat.

lethal strike.desc: attack for 4 damage. Usable once per combat.

critical strike.desc: cut enemy health in half. Usable once per combat. Ends turn.

jump attack.desc: jump attack the enemy from afar, dealing 3 damage. Ends turn.

injure.desc: apply injury to an enemy in melee for 2 turns, hindering combat capabilities.

cripple.desc: cripple the enemy for 3 turns, hindering their movement and adding chance to hesitate.

taunt.desc: force all foes to engage you and gain block equal to enemies engaged.

cleaving charge.desc: charge toward a unit and deal 1 damage to everyone in melee range.

charge tackle.desc: tackle the enemy from afar, dealing 2 damage and stunning you both for a turn. Refreshes moveset.

zeal.desc: deal 1 damage and heal for the damage dealt.

guard break.desc: deal damage equal to twice the target's block in melee.

defensive pose.desc: gain 1 block each turn for 3 turns.

crystallize.desc: gain 2 block and deal 1 damage to attackers. Ends turn.

parry.desc: parry the next attack, stunning the enemy if successful.

greater parry.desc: parry if hit within 3 turns. Ends turn.

stop charge.desc: whenever an enemy engages you, stop and stun them. Cannot be used injured. Lasts 2 turns.

camouflage.desc: force all enemies to change target.

rejuvenate.desc: heal 1 damage and apply vulnerability for 1 turn.

heal allies.desc: heal 1 damage of the most wounded ally and yourself using 1 mana.

recover.desc: recover from injury, vulnerability, burn, and cripple.

omniscience.desc: refresh moveset and gain insight to everyone's moves using 1 mana.

clarity.desc: refresh moveset for free. Usable once per combat.

confuse.desc: confuse the enemy for a turn, making their attacks hit themselves.

weaken.desc: apply vulnerability to an enemy, doubling their damage taken and healing received for 1 turn.

charge mana.desc: gain 2 mana at the cost of 1 health. Ends turn.

attract mana.desc: gain 1 mana per turn for 3 turns, but become vulnerable for 1 turn. Ends turn.

replicate mana.desc: gain 3 mana. Usable once per combat.

lightning.desc: use 2 mana to deal 2 damage to all foes.

torrent.desc: use 1 mana to deal 3 damage and push back a foe.

stone shot.desc: use 1 mana to deal 3 damage and cause cripple and injury for 2 turns.

phase.desc: use 2 mana to become invulnerable for 2 turns.

barrier.desc: use 1 mana to give 4 block to you and all your allies.

mind break.desc: all foes get greatly increased chance to hesitate. Uses 1 mana.

redirect.desc: redirect the next incoming attack towards your target.

insight.desc: observe the enemy, gaining insight about their next moves and apply vulnerability for 1 turn.

rot.desc: deal damage equal to target's missing health using 2 mana.

torment.desc: cut the target's current health in half using 3 mana.

kill.desc: deal 99 damage to the target using 5 mana.

stone form.desc: turn yourself into stone for 2 turns, becoming invulnerable but unable to do anything.

teleport.desc: automatically disengage every turn for 5 turns using 1 mana.

blink.desc: Disengage as a free action. Uses 1 mana.

fireball.desc: deal 3 damage to a target and nearby units using 1 mana.

incinerate.desc: set everyone nearby on fire using 1 mana.

dispel.desc: remove all active status effects in combat

siphon.desc: siphon the mana of everyone in combat into you.

haste.desc: gain bonus actions equal to current mana storage. Cannot be used when crippled. Uses breath.

ice nova.desc: deal 2 damage to everyone but yourself using 2 mana. Hit targets are slowed for 2 turns.

petrify.desc: turn target into stone for 3 turns using 1 mana.

long thrust.desc: impale the enemy with your %w from afar.

guarded thrust.desc: impale the enemy from afar for 2 damage. Gain 2 block.

shoot.desc: shoot at the enemy for 1 damage from range.

exploding shot.desc: Deal 2 damage to an area. Can be shot in melee.

triple shot.desc: deal 1 damage three times from range.

quadruple shot.desc: deal 1 damage four times from range.

relentless shot.desc: deal 1 damage three times to all enemies. Must be away.

blinding shot.desc: shoot your %w at the enemy's eyes, blinding and forcing them to change their target.

penetrating shot.desc: deal 2 damage to one enemy and 1 damage to another enemy behind it. Ignores armor. Can be shot in melee.

quicksilver shot.desc: deal 2 piercing damage and apply burn. Ignores armor. Can be shot in melee.

volley.desc: deal 2 damage to an area from range.

swing.desc: swing your weapon at the enemy.

bola throw.desc: throw a bola at the enemy.

whirring throw.desc: attack for 1 damage and apply vulnerability for 1 turn.

ricochet throw.desc: apply bleeding to all enemies for 1 turn.

cleansing strike.desc: strike with your %w, burning them if supernatural.

stab.desc: stab the enemy with your %w for 2 damage, ignoring armor. Ends turn.

chop.desc: kill if the enemy's health is lower than 5. Otherwise deal 2 damage.

mark.desc: apply vulnerability, injury, and cripple for 2 turns.

bless.desc: heal 3 damage over 3 turns for all allies. Must be away. Usable once per combat

glass form.desc: enter glass form. Must be away.

spider form.desc: enter spider form as a free action. Must be away.

spirit form.desc: enter spirit form and become invincible for 1 turn. Must be away. Ends turn.

mouse form.desc: enter mouse form. Must be away.

lich form.desc: enter lich form using 1 mana. Must be away.

blood parasite.desc: using 1 health, make target enemy take 1 damage each turn.

blood siphon.desc: using 1 health, deal 2 damage and heal yourself for the damage dealt. Melee only.

life siphon.desc: deal 1 damage to all enemies and heal yourself for the damage dealt using 2 mana. Must not be injured.

smite.desc: deal 4 damage to a vulnerable foe.

hunt mode.desc: enter hunt mode. Must be away.

suck.desc: deal 1 damage and heal yourself for the damage dealt.

blood drain.desc: deal 2 damage and heal yourself for the damage dealt.

weave web.desc: make nearby enemy unable to move.

strangle.desc: strangle an enemy for 2 damage over 2 turns.

toxicity.desc: apply poison to everyone to deal 3 damage over 3 turns.

curse of doom.desc: everyone takes 1 damage per turn until the caster is dead.

curse of disability.desc: apply injury, cripple, and vulnerability. Lasts 5 turns. Usable once per combat.

paralyze.desc: stun and apply vulnerability to an enemy in melee for 1 turn. Ends turn.

dive.desc: dive into water, becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

burrow.desc: burrow into the ground, becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

summon ally.desc: summon an ally to fight with you. Ends turn.

regenerate.desc: heal 2 damage over 2 turns. Ends turn.
